title: Perfect evaluation isomorphisms
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], K a quasi-coherent perfect derived object [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex], and D an object of D(O_X) equal to R\mathcal Hom(K,O_X) [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Let adj be the natural bijections Hom(A,RHom(B,C)) = Hom(A tensor B,C), with their full three-variable naturality equations [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction]. Define e as adj of the equality identification D to RHom(K,O_X). Then for every N in D(O_X), the adjunct under adj of the composite (N tensor D) tensor K to N tensor (D tensor K) to N tensor O_X to N is invertible. Tensor products, associators and unitors is those of the derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure].

proof.text: Substitute the given equality D=RHom(K,O_X). Compare adj with the fixed canonical family. For each N, naturality in the test object A shows that e_0^(-1) composed with adj is postcomposition by an endomorphism t_N of RHom(K,N). Yoneda and the bijectivity of both families show that t_N is invertible. Applying this at O_X and N and using associator naturality gives phi_adj ; t_N = (id_N tensor t_O) ; phi_canonical. Thus invertibility of the canonical maps implies invertibility for adj. The private helpers changeAdjunction and evaluationIso_changeAdjunction prove this calculation in a general monoidal category.

Unpack the perfectness hypothesis to choose a neighbourhood U_x containing each point x, a strictly perfect complex P_x and a derived isomorphism K|U_x ≅ QP_x. Their union is top. Apply the local canonical evaluation theorem to obtain invertibility of the restricted canonical evaluation on every U_x.

Use DerivedCategory.isIso_iff to test the canonical evaluation on all homology functors. Exact restriction commutes with homology via overFunctor.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso, so every homology map restricts to an isomorphism on every U_x. Apply the sheaf-module open-cover isomorphism criterion, then the derived homology criterion. This proves canonical evaluation globally and completes Step 1; it also works on the empty scheme.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof of change of adjunction and descent on homology; local computation isolated from Stacks Tags 08DQ and 08DM.
